sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:59

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:59:1
items.html: These are not dependent on merit, which is Hesed, but are dependent on the Mazal, etc., in the secret of her six extremities, which spread and shine in him. As written above, in the passage beginning “Bina spreads”: that the discernment of the Mochin of Neshama, which are for endurance and sustaining, is drawn from the GAR of Bina, which are the discernment of the light of Hesed, namely Hassadim covered from the illumination of Hochma; and they are the discernment of merit, since those Mochin are exceedingly refined and no restriction can touch them. However, sons, life and sustenance, which include the two kinds of bounty — namely blessing and freedom — and “to sustain everything,” cannot come from the GAR of Bina, but only from the discernment of the ascent of AVI to the GAR of AA, where they couple upon the MAN of the Mazal, as above; and then ZA can also receive from the ZAT of Bina, who bestow the illumination of Hochma, and therefore he has the two kinds of bounty. Study it there well.
